text:

Most AI teams we talk to are spending the majority of their ML engineering time optimizing a pipelinen stage that isn't actually what's holding them back. 

Labeling is the most common culprit — it's visible, expensive, and easy to justify resourcing. But when we map the pipeline, the real constraint could be upstream in curation or downstream in validation. By the time that's clear, a quarter of engineering effort is already spent. 

We built a 2-minute diagnostic that identifies which stage it actually is for your specific setup, and generates a prioritized report your team can act on.
